normativeSource: CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1, 2025-03-26 CRD, sections 7.2.1 and 11.1
rule: When a grid container's size depends on its tracks, track percentages act as auto while intrinsic container sizes are calculated, then resolve against the resulting inner size for final grid layout.

derivations.overflow: item extends 8px beyond its 16px column track
item extends 6px beyond its 10px row track

derivations.intrinsicBasis: item establishes max-content grid size 24×16px independently on both axes
derivations.overflow: item extends 8px right and 6px down beyond its tracks
item is flush with the column track and extends 4px below the row track

limitations: This fixed fixture does not admit general CSS track syntax.
It does not cover minmax(calc()), fit-content(calc()), nested Grid, gaps, borders, writing-mode changes, WPT, hardware GPU, physical Android, or iOS compositor-after pixels.
